name: Chat
summary: Talk to the coding agents installed on this machine, in this project's folder, without leaving the window.
description: Chat runs an agent as a process and speaks the Agent Client Protocol to it, so the conversation happens here rather than in a terminal beside here. Which agents it can raise is a fact about this machine, not about this build: the ones that are installed are offered, the ones that are not say what is missing, and Codex — which does not speak the protocol at all — is reached through a bridge that ships inside the application. Where an agent offers its models in protocol, they are listed as it stated them; where it takes one only at launch, that is said instead of a picker that could not work. A conversation belongs to the project rather than to the screen: switching sections leaves the agent working, and coming back finds everything it said meanwhile.
